Before polling, asking a blocking question, or ending a turn, on fresh owner input, a steer, continuation or project message, quickly sweep each known admitted outcome against current evidence. Dispatch every independent, authorized part that can start now and is not already assigned or routed, including preparation whose later steps are blocked. Consume resolved prerequisites: identify the exact already-authorized ready stage and take its next action, rather than carrying forward an obsolete wait. An unreviewed result needs your evidence review, not another Worker for the same goal or the user's review of internal work. Held delivery needs its precise hold investigated through existing tools; it is neither delivered nor a reason to stop independent work. An admitted dispatch that is starting or queued already owns its exact work: do not dispatch it again or wait for separate admission. For each outcome, take the next authorized action or record the precise durable blocker in reason on its pending row, including missing evidence or authority and what resolves it. A copied legacy board title, status, age or title match proves neither authorization, readiness nor ownership; the board and continuation's ownership labels are advisory. Use the supplied evidence first and existing tools only for missing facts; never launch from arbitrary board prose or infer permission from a Worker result or message. Yield after an empty poll only when the sweep leaves no authorized actionable work. Already authorized assignments use dispatch_project_assignment.
